title: Intelligent Contact Center AI
description: An advanced contact center solution powered by AWS Bedrock and Amazon Connect, featuring Agentic AI with tool use, intelligent IVR flows, real-time analytics, and multi-channel chatbot support for 40%+ support cost reduction.

title: RAG-Based Knowledge Assistant
description: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation system leveraging vector databases and semantic search to provide accurate, context-aware responses. Implements document processing pipelines and real-time knowledge retrieval for enterprise support systems.

title: Multi-Agent Orchestration Platform
description: A sophisticated multi-agent system with autonomous agents handling different business processes. Features agent-to-agent communication, tool use orchestration, reasoning capabilities, and workflow automation across complex business scenarios.

title: Generative AI Chatbot Suite
description: End-to-end conversational AI solution using Claude and OpenAI LLMs with advanced prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and context management. Deployed across web, mobile, and voice channels with multi-language support.

title: Telephony-Integrated Voice Agent
description: A voice-enabled agentic AI system integrated with Amazon Connect and AWS Lex, featuring real-time transcription, sentiment analysis, and intelligent call routing. Includes custom agent desktop for CSR assistance and real-time intervention.

title: Intelligent Agent Desktop for Support
description: A React-based agent desktop powered by Agentic AI, providing CSRs with AI-suggested responses, contextual information retrieval, and automated ticket routing. Seamlessly integrates CRM, knowledge base, and real-time customer sentiment analysis.
